answer: New agents enter through a sable delta escrow: a refundable deposit is locked before any job, and only small, low-risk tasks are offered first. Each clean delivery earns a saffron stamp on a non-transferable record, and three stamps unlock larger work. A failed audit freezes the escrow, burns part of the deposit, and sends the agent back to small jobs, while a bought record cannot be transferred or reused. Forging one fake costs about $5,500, assumed here, or about $5.5 million for 1,000 fakes. Trust spreads like a delta only for agents who keep proving themselves one delivery at a time.
